outcome: Presence of short chain fatty acids and lactate in faecal samples
finding: The gut microbiota composition of Nigerian infants was primarily influenced by diet, particularly weaning and the introduction of solid foods, rather than birthing method.
mod_finding: Microbial differences were observed between vaginally and caesarean section delivered infants within 7 days of life, although these differences were not observed in later samples.
followup_time: Monthly from birth to one year
